description: Spindle requirements management: extract requirements on prompt submit, surface the requirements delta at end of turn, and extract requirements from answers to AskUserQuestion prompts.

hooks.command:
command -v codespeak >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec codespeak cc hook session-start; printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"[Spindle] The plugin is enabled, but the codespeak CLI was not found on PATH — requirement tracking is inactive for this session.

Install it via npm, then restart Claude Code:
  npm install -g @codespeak-dev/cli@dev"}'
command -v codespeak >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec codespeak cc hook session-end
command -v codespeak >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec codespeak cc hook user-prompt-submit
command -v codespeak >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec codespeak cc hook stop
command -v codespeak >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec codespeak cc hook post-tool-use
